item.title: 8600 FT – Riding Up The Whole Enchilada – Moab, UT
item.description: “The Whole Enchilada” is one of mountain biking’s most epic trails—attracting expert-level riders from around the globe to Moab, Utah, to challenge its 8600-foot descent over raw terrain of rugged rock drops and boulder fields. But no one has ever tried to ride up every inch of the trail—until now. Equally mentally challenging as physical, “8600 FT” is a 1.5-hour feature-length film of Braydon Bringhurst’s attempt to summit "The Whole Enchilada." Continue reading →

item.title: New Race Face Turbine Crank
item.description: September, 20, 2022 - The next evolution of the venerable Turbine crank is here. Originally built in 1993 for a growing segment of North Shore riders who wanted a stiff and responsive crank without the weight penalty, the new Turbine honors that Shore legacy with the burly alloy workhorse you’ve come to know and love. item.title: Nukeproof Enters the USA With Brick and Mortar Stores
item.description: (November 30, 2022 - Salt Lake City, UT) Nukeproof mountain bikes, components and accessories will soon be easier to find in the US.
